program.help:
Change channel display colors in an XML parameter file.
Unlike most ndmanager-plugins, ndm_recolorchannels takes its arguments directly on the command line rather than from the parameter file's programs section. It is typically run standalone, not via ndm_start.
USAGE
ndm_recolorchannels [OPTIONS] xml_file
-c ch1-ch2,color range of channel IDs (0-based) and hexadecimal color code
EXAMPLES
# Color tetrode 1 red, tetrode 2 green, channel 17 blue ndm_recolorchannels -c 0-3,ff0000 -c 4-7,00ff00 -c 17,0000ff session.xml
# Color all 64 channels of an 8-shank probe in 8 groups of 8 for i in $(seq 0 7); do start=$((i*8)); end=$((start+7)) ndm_recolorchannels -c ${start}-${end},$(printf '%06x' $((RANDOM % 0xFFFFFF))) session.xml done
NOTES
Only XML parameter files are supported. For YAML sessions, convert first with ndm_xml2yaml, edit the neuroscope/channels/colors section directly in the YAML, or use the ndmanager GUI channel color panel.
Color codes are standard 6-digit RGB hex (e.g. ff0000 = red, 00ff00 = green, 0000ff = blue, ffffff = white, 000000 = black). The leading '#' is not included.
The -c flag can be repeated any number of times. Ranges are inclusive (ch1-ch2 colors channels ch1, ch1+1, ..., ch2). A single channel can be specified as ch,color (omitting the range separator).
